title: Post-fix matrix: 80 runs, no recurrence
summary: After widening acquisition retry to EEXIST/EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES: isolated concurrency file 40/40 passed; full suite at normal parallelism 30/30 passed; full suite serial 10/10 passed. Counts declared before running. Bounded non-reproduction, not proof of absence: at a 10% per-run rate, 30 parallel runs would miss a recurrence about 4% of the time.
